local.L1: Dorchester County Courthouse, 5200 East Jim Bilton Boulevard, St. George, SC 29477, Court of Common Pleas and General Sessions, First Judicial Circuit (sccourts.org).
local.L2: Troy Knight Judicial Complex, 212 Deming Way, Summerville. Houses Dorchester Family Court, the Summerville Magistrate Court and Central Bond Court.
local.L3: Summerville Municipal Court, 200 S Main Street, 2nd Floor. Traffic and criminal misdemeanor cases inside town limits. A town court, different from the magistrate court.
local.L4: Summerville Police Department, 108 North Cedar St. Directs people to CrashDocs for collision reports. Its Traffic Safety Unit includes officers trained in at-scene, technical and reconstruction collision investigation (summervillesc.gov).
local.L5: SC Highway Patrol Troop Six covers Beaufort, Berkeley, Charleston, Colleton, Dorchester and Jasper counties, headquartered at 2070 Northbrook Blvd, North Charleston. Post B covers Dorchester from the Colleton patrol office in Walterboro. Troop Nine is the Multi-disciplinary Accident Investigation Team (MAIT). Never say which troop responds to a crash.
local.L6: HCA Healthcare Summerville Hospital, 295 Midland Parkway, 174 beds, 24-hour ER and a 10-bed pediatric ER. Not a trauma center.
local.L7: Roper St. Francis Berkeley Hospital, 100 Callen Boulevard, Summerville mailing address but in Berkeley County, 24/7 emergency services with pediatric-ready accreditation. Not a trauma center.
local.L8: MUSC in Charleston, Adult Level I and the state's only Pediatric Level I trauma center. Trident Medical Center, North Charleston, Adult Level II. Say a patient may be taken there, never will be.
local.L9: Dorchester Road (SC 642) had 519 collisions and 6 deaths in Dorchester County in 2024, the most of any road in the county (SCDPS Fact Book, as recorded by officers). Dorchester Road at Old Trolley Road 53, at Ladson Road 49, at Bacons Bridge Road (SC 165) 41. SCDOT 2024 average daily traffic 45,300 between Old Trolley Road and the Charleston County line.
local.L10: US 17A is Main Street in Summerville (SCDOT). SCDOT 2024 average daily traffic 33,100 between 5th Street North and the Berkeley County line. I-26 Exit 199 is US 17A (North Main Street).
local.L11: US 78 is 5th Street North in Summerville (SCDOT). The Fact Book lists US-78 at SC-165 with 56 collisions in 2024, the most of any Dorchester intersection. Do not call that junction Bacons Bridge Road.
local.L12: Central Avenue is S-13 in Dorchester County, 198 collisions in 2024, fifth among Dorchester roads.
local.L13: I-26 interchanges near Summerville per SCDOT: Exit 194 Jedburg Road, Exit 197 Nexton Parkway, Exit 199 US 17A (North Main Street), Exit 203 College Park Road, all labeled Berkeley County, and Exit 205 US 78 (University Boulevard), Charleston County. 2024 average daily traffic on I-26 was 89,700 between US 17A and College Park Road and 107,600 between College Park Road and US 78. In Berkeley County, I-26 at College Park Road had 113 collisions and Jedburg Road at I-26 had 103 in 2024.
local.L14: Berlin G. Myers Parkway Phase III, a $160 million SCDOT project, opened fully to traffic in late April 2025. Never give it a route number.
local.L15: Dorchester County 2024 (Fact Book): 3,958 collisions, 32 fatal, 37 killed, 60 serious injury collisions with 81 seriously injured, 809 other injury collisions with 1,226 injured. Death rate 21.2 per 100,000, up from 8.8 in 2023. Most collisions 3 to 6 PM (972), most fatal 6 to 9 PM (9). Victims: 66 motorcyclists (7 killed), 36 pedestrians (4 killed), 18 bicyclists (1 killed). NHTSA estimates 19 alcohol-impaired deaths in Dorchester County in 2024, up from 8. 118 non-fatal DUI collisions.
local.L16: Who investigated Dorchester County collisions in 2024: Highway Patrol 1,517 (23 fatal), Summerville Police 1,321 (3 fatal), Sheriff's Office 590. Summerville Police also investigated 416 in Berkeley County and 21 in Charleston County.
local.L17: The Town of Summerville sits in three counties. Census 2025 estimates, 44,724 residents in the Dorchester part, 5,798 in Berkeley, 2,655 in Charleston. Population 50,915 at the 2020 Census, estimated 53,177 in 2025. Summerville is a town, not a city.
local.L18: South Carolina magistrates hear civil cases up to $7,500 (S.C. Code 22-3-10). Injury claims above that are filed in the Court of Common Pleas.
